description:
Goal
Dissolve the cross-executable input-merge into a cumulative contribution fact, collapsing the global two-solve into the single fixpoint. Pull becomes push: callees stop scanning callers; callers contribute.

What
- Add cumulative FactKey::InputShape(ExecutableKey) (list it in ClaimShape::is_cumulative, drive.rs:91) backed by a ContributionMap over the Stage-2 agreement lattice (mirror ReturnDemandMap, semantic.rs:604).
- Each caller DeriveExecutableTransport(E) contributes its CallArg shapes keyed by callee ExecutableKey, via a new JobEffects channel routed in complete_job (world.rs:562-606), exactly like return_demand_contributions.
- project_executable_input_source (jobs/transport.rs:2435) READS InputShape(E) instead of scanning contexts (delete the incoming_executable_input_positions / collect_call_arg_input_sources caller scans, ~2114/2623). Consumer rule: Agreed(S) and (no own-demand anchor OR own-demand==S) -> merged shape S; else own-demand shape (preserves the current anchor_shape.is_none_or(==first) condition at ~1110-1118).
- Remove the first solve() (jobs/transport.rs:900) and collect_executable_input_constraints two-phase staging; the input binding now arrives as a settled fact under the barrier.
- seed_callable_flow_capture_inputs / seed_callable_resolution_capture_inputs (927/1010) become contributions to the resolution executable input slot.

Verify
shadow==monolith green; contract suite green; assert the two-solve is gone (single solve / no local_shapes pre-pass); zero warnings.
title: Stage 2: InputShape(E) cumulative contribution; pull->push; collapse the two-solve
